chapter: Fats Waller, marriage and Indian school tours
title: Favorite Waller tunes
summary: Moore lists favorite Fats Waller songs and the 'Jitterbug Waltz'.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Listening to classical music, then and now

blocks.x: Are there any of his songs that are especially memorable for you, that you enjoy playing a lot. Do you play 'Ain't Misbehavin' a lot or 'Honeysuckle Rose?'

'Honeysuckle' yes. 'Crazy 'Bout My Baby,' I like that, too. 'Crazy 'bout my baby, my baby's crazy 'bout me,' I like that, most of the 'Jitterbug Waltz,' that's specialties by Waller / out of this world and he played the organ, too, when he plays the 'Jitterbug Waltz' on the organ, I love that, too. Everything he did, nobody can copy, like Armstrong.
Well, a selection like 'Jitterbug Waltz' doesn't really lend itself very well to being

played very well with a trombone lead, with it's interval leaps.
I din't feature it on my horn, I just like to listen to it. I didn't try it, although I love the song.
It can be done, certainly, but you know --
But I have done "Honeysuckle Rose" and "Misbehavin'"---sing some of that. Then other things that Fats wrote.
